reviews.text: I sincerely thank Dr. Giangrandi, his colleague, and his assistant for their professionalism.

Despite their undoubted kindness, unfortunately they completely misdiagnosed. Our 13-year-old cat was vomiting frequently, and they said it was a hairball problem on March 22nd, even though tests the month before had already indicated high albumin levels, so they should have at least suspected it. Today, April 22nd, the cat died from a very aggressive lymphoma of the duodenum, pancreas, and ocular glaucoma. She lost 1 kg in a month.
For this reason, I can't recommend the Spaziani clinic, which may have fair prices but isn't really doing its job.
There is no parking nearby, the vet is very professional
I've been a longtime customer of theirs. The place is very clean, and the vets are very knowledgeable and kind. Anyone who asks me about good vets always recommends Spaziani.

Always professional and helpful. We always get along great... Even though our dachshund isn't an easygoing person. I recommend them to anyone looking for good vets at a fair price, who don't try to profit from unnecessary things. Excellent!
Fantastic owner, excellent staff, attention and care for our little furry friends
Very professional and kind with the "patient" I highly recommend them

Great staff, ready to diagnose and treat your pet!

I went in with my cat, and didn't knew Italian and they went above and beyond to communicate with me and treat Stitch.

Definitely recommend!
Courtesy and professionalism in a small clinic
